To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The expression of pro-enkephalin A mRNA is regulated independently from phenylethanolamin N-methyltransferse mRNA in cultured adrenal chromaffin cell.

the expression of proen-kephalin A mRNA and phenylethanoloamine N-methyl-transferase (PNMT)mRNA in response to c AMP analogues, forskoli and phorbol-esters was examined in cultu-res of bovine adrenal chormaffin cells.

the expression of proenkaephlin A (ProEnka) mRNA and phenyl-ethanolamine N-metyltransferase (PNM) mRNA in response cAMP analogues and phorbol-esters was examined in cultures bovine adrenal chromafin cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the regulation of proenkaephlin A (proEnkA) mRNA expression in cultured chromaffin cells, and the effects of phorbol estes, forskolin and glucocorticoid on the expression of proEnkA mRNA in cultured bovine adrenomedullary chromaffin cells.
the regulation of the biosynthesis and secretion of catecholamines and enkephalins by chromaffin cells in culture.
the molecular and cellular mechanisms involved in the regulation of the biosynthetic pathways of the adrenal medulla.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the regulation of Proenkephalin and PNMT gene expression in chromaffin cells is a complex process that is regulated by a number of second messengers, including Ca2+, cAMP and phorbol myristate acetate.
PNMT mRNA is regulated by cAMP and glucocorticoids, while ProEnk A is regulated by cGMP, phorbol esterase, glucocorticoids and dexamethasome.

the expression of Pro-Enk A mRNA is differentially regulated by cAMP elevation and by tumor promoting phorbols, whereas the expression of PNMT mRNA is differentially and coordinately regulated by cAMP and glucocorticoid hormones.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of PNMT and proenkephalins are regulated independently by the cAMP pathway, and the phorbol 13,14-dibutyrate (PDBu) and phorbol 4,13-didecylate (4-PDD) pathway.
the control of PNOMT and ProEnkA mRNA expression is mediated by different second messenger pathways.
the expression of Proenkephalin and PNMT mRNAs are coordinately regulated in chromaffin cells by glucocorticoids, but differentially regulated in response to second messenger mechanisms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the regulation of PNMT expression by glucocorticoids and phorbol-ester is a highly complex process that involves the interaction of several signaling pathways.
the expression of Proenkephalin and PNMT mRNA is differentially regulated in chromaffin cells in response to c AMP elevation and phorbols.
the expression of Proenkephalin mRNA and PNMT mRNA are differentially regulated by the tumor promoting agents.
